## Search Tips

### Find by Topic
```bash
# Service issues
grep -r "service" ECRR_REPORTS/*.md

# Deployment reports
ls ECRR_REPORTS/DEPLOYMENT*.md

# Nightly runs
ls ECRR_REPORTS/NIGHTLY*.md

# BossCat framework
grep -r "bosscat" ECRR_REPORTS/*.md -i
```

### Find by Date
```bash
# October 8, 2025
ls ECRR_REPORTS/*20251008*.md

# Last 7 days
find ECRR_REPORTS -name "*.md" -mtime -7
```

### Find by Compliance
```bash
# Full ECRR reports
grep -l "## E.*Examine" ECRR_REPORTS/*.md | xargs grep -l "## C.*Clean"

# Missing sections
grep -L "Examine" ECRR_REPORTS/*.md
```
